overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the Law requires recording votes and actions in minutes, not formal votes on every motion, so the Board's failure to vote on September 17, 2015 motions was not a violation. Closed by informal action.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board failed to take formal votes on motions made at its September 17, 2015 meeting.
allegations.key_passage: Because the Law does not require the Board to take such votes, it did not violate the Open Meeting Law by failing to do so during its September 17, 2015 meeting.
